title: Geographia III.8 - Dacia
creator: Klaudios Ptolemaios
witness: Manuscript tradition; editio princeps with maps
scope: A coordinate catalogue of Dacia between the Tisia the Danube and the Hierasus; towns and tribes only
note: Survives as numbers; every drawn map of it is a later restoration.

title: Tabula Peutingeriana segm. VII–VIII
creator: Unknown imperial compilers; medieval copyist
scope: The cursus publicus; road stations and mileages rather than settlement generally
note: Dated by its fourth-century content rather than its c. 1200 parchment, following the trench's stated rule.

title: Hereford Mappa Mundi
creator: Circle of Richard of Haldingham (attrib.)
scope: The whole orbis terrarum arranged on a theological schema
note: Reproduction rights for any specific witness image are not cleared by this value.

title: Portolan chart
creator: Pietro Vesconte
scope: Mediterranean and Black Sea coastlines; the interior is not surveyed
note: Scope is what makes inland silence extra_muros rather than omission.

title: Chorographia Transylvaniae
creator: Johannes Honterus
repository: Repository unconfirmed - recorded as likely Budapest

title: Dacia - Parergon
creator: Abraham Ortelius
scope: Antiquarian reconstruction of the ancient provinces over modern geometry
note: An antiquarian restoration; readings from it are reconstructed rather than contemporary.

title: Map of Wallachia
creator: Constantin Cantacuzino, stolnic; printed by Chrysanthos

title: Descriptio Moldaviae - map
creator: Dimitrie Cantemir
note: The manuscript travelled to Russia; the print carried the content.

title: Josephinische Landesaufnahme
creator: Habsburg General Staff plane-table parties
scope: The Habsburg lands including Transylvania; Oltenia and Moldavia lie outside it
note: Classified from birth and therefore complete.

title: Russian General Staff map
creator: Russian General Staff
scope: The Principalities under Russian administration; the survey stops at the mountains
note: First geodetic lattice for the region.
